why_hard: The packet says 'maximally tolerated GDMT' many times and lists pharmacy last-fill dates, but never gives a GDMT start date or duration. For a non-ischemic patient that duration is required.

action_reasoning: Non-ischemic, so rule 6 needs months on GDMT. That fact is absent. Pend and ask for GDMT start dates. Everything else passes.
